title: Pressure Drop
prompt: drum n bass, uk garage, fred again, joy orbison, skrillex
description: Rowdy jump-up drum and bass built around a grinding sawtooth reese bass with a heaving LFO wobble filter — the bass IS the track. Jungle breaks and jungbass stabs drive a relentless 176bpm rollercoaster through three peaks separated by two valleys: the first peak ruptures into a dark mid-section with a climbing bassline variant before a full breakdown and a brutal final peak, then a slow dissolve out.
